headline: Remember the 5 layers of the epidermis
stat_note: "Come Let's Get Sun Burnt", top to bottom
body:
C = Stratum corneum
L = Stratum lucidum
G = Stratum granulosum
S = Stratum spinosum
B = Stratum basale

headline: Count your vertebrae like meal times
stat_note: breakfast at 7, lunch at 12, dinner at 5
body: 7 cervical (neck), 12 thoracic (chest), 5 lumbar (lower back). Add 5 fused sacral and 4 coccygeal for 33 in total.
source: Source: StatPearls (NCBI), Anatomy, Back, Vertebral Column

headline: Your fingernails grow twice as fast as your toenails
body: Toenails averaged just 1.62 mm a month in a study of healthy young adults.
source: Source: Yaemsiri et al., J Eur Acad Dermatol Venereol, 2010
